notes: You can now attach real content to your messages — and the assistant genuinely understands images. Tap the attach button in chat to add photos from your gallery, take a picture, or pick files; they appear as chips above the composer while they upload, and they survive app restarts with the conversation. When you send an image, it is really sent: the backend validates and decodes the actual bytes and a vision-capable model analyses the real picture, then answers right in the chat — ask 'What is this?', 'Explain this screenshot.' or 'Read the text in this image.' Follow-up questions keep the image context, so you don't re-attach anything. When something fails — a corrupted file, an unsupported format, an upload problem — the app says exactly what happened and offers a retry instead of making something up. Same monochrome design, same workspace, everything else unchanged.
